senses.gloss: m. (cmp. Arab. sabanu, nomen oppidi … a quo panni nomen acceperunt (Freytag); cmp. σάβανον, sabanum) a cloth, esp. a head-cover which fell down over the shoulders, sibni.
units: Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ bot. כריך סִבְנֵיה עליהון (ed. Zyt. סבונה, corr. acc.) he tied his sibni around them; Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ top סִבְנֵה.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:14:3">Cant. R. to V, 14</cite> <he>אפי׳ סבניה לא הוה יכיל למיסבל וכ׳</he> (he became so weak from studying that) he could not even carry his sibni (in his hand), but others had to take it off for him; v. next w.—Pl. <cite ref="O00077"><he>סִבְנִין</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 19 סכנין (corr. acc.) a female head-cover, corresp. to סדינין for males.
